key_insight: pyDOF is a Python library that automates the constrained design of customizable discrete forward and inverse filters in physical space.
engineering_relevance: It helps CFD and signal-processing users generate tailored filters with enforceable properties such as monotonicity, positivity, and smoothing, reducing manual filter-tuning effort.
method: Uses constrained optimization to design symmetric discrete filter transfer functions.
Supports forward and inverse filters, including van Cittert inverse design with user-controlled reconstruction order.
Includes adaptive stencil selection and automatic export of coefficients to plain text files.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a software framework and feature set, but does not provide quantitative benchmark results or validation data.
watch_item: Filter quality and stability will still depend on chosen constraints, stencil size, and reconstruction order, so misuse can lead to over- or under-smoothing.
paper_title: pyDOF: a Python library for the design of discrete forward and inverse filters
